dialogues.speaker: Lantainen
dialogues.text: Ugh... Nothing fuels me for patrol like a warm, delicious loaf of bread...

dialogues.speaker: Lantainen
dialogues.text: I'm getting supplies needed for patrol, but it looks like we're out of stock on my favorite, the Mushroom Phantasm.

dialogues.speaker: Lantainen
dialogues.text: It's a new bread Ms. Beryna came up with. Everyone loves it so much that there's never any left in stock.

dialogues.speaker: Lantainen
dialogues.text: *sigh* Just thinking about not getting any Mushroom Phantasm drains all my motivation...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think I know how to make them.

dialogues.speaker: Lantainen
dialogues.text: If that's the case, could you make some Mushroom Phantasm for me? Don't worry, I won't let you work for nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Lantainen
dialogues.text: Ugh... Nothing fuels me for patrol like a warm, delicious loaf of bread...

response.speaker: Lantainen
response.text: *sigh* Just thinking about not getting any Mushroom Phantasm drains all my motivation...

dialogues.speaker: Lantainen
dialogues.text: Mmm, it smells so good... just the warm, familiar aroma I know!

dialogues.speaker: Lantainen
dialogues.text: Now that everything's ready, I can head out for patrol.
